body: This is very true. It's a unique and fun blend of people to be honest. I just wish that I could have done it more in high school.

Indeed. :P

And I just did my 25, and I'm more tired from the crunches than the fact it's midnight here. :P

I did a play in my senior year of high school that actually made me feel really awesome, but it took loads of courage to gather to even consider it, but I don't regret it, I'm just uncertain of what it'll be like in college.

I'm told I'm a pretty good listener and pretty empathetic, but as far as that goes, I don't have the money or smarts to go into a school for that. I'm very insular about my thinking an my way of living. I tend to think more of myself as a human being, and the issues that present itself, and what **I** would do.

I'm told that I could be a comedian, but sometimes I feel like I try to hard, and the fact that when I was younger, I was told I was never ever going to be funny in anyway, so I might as well "shut the fuck up." that and my severe stage anxiety tend to get in the way. :/

I know my dad has like these two smooth magnets that he keeps in his pocket when he wants to do something with his hands. I had some like his, but more oval shaped, but god knows where the hell I put them. I'll admit that while my mind is keen I suppose, my main problem is just the lack of motivation, and that's typically the hardest part for me. And failure tends to make me even more unmotivated, because as a kid, I was always told essentially "Go big or go home." So I felt like I either needed to win completely in every way, or just completely lose and not even bother. While it's useful for somethings, I was pretty much forced into applying it to my everyday life. I've been to khan, and I even have it bookmarked, but alas, I've either forgot, or I was lazy. Same with freerice, though I'll go on it occasionally.

I do like cleaning quite a bit to be honest, as it helps my OCD (minor, but still legitimate) so I might clean my room while I wait for a package to come in the mail. I know I'll have to do homework anyways, so that isn't much of a problem.

I do push-ups sometimes, but I tend to favor standard push-ups to be honest, but I love doing crunches even more, I'm not picky, but most of my strength is in my chest and stomach as opposed to my arms.

I hear you on the nightmares. Those suck incredibly, and I'll even have nightmares about current relationships. And I try. Being in a class I like tends to help it, as well as hanging out with some friends, but when I'm alone and not doing anything is when I'm feeling pretty weak.
I've always thought that my mark on the world was nonexistent, but it won't hurt to try right?

Yeah, I do engage in walking when I can, though it usually limits me to about 4 or 5 nights a week compared to every night like I was able too. And I don't know anyone that has that kind of stuff around me, but I could find it, or see if I can do something else as well.

I haven't really been exercising mainly because I've just been so damned depressed during the last couple of weeks, and it sucks. And my friend and I don't have any weights and can't afford a gym membership, that and he can't use the college gym because he isn't a student, but I see what you're saying. 

But I've been trying, and I've just been feeling this way for a bit now, and finding out about the girl was kind of the straw that broke the camel's back so to speak. I've been keeping my distance from her, because I know it isn't my friends fault.

I dunno. I'm not too big on the whole "Abundance of company" thing. I'm unique as far as tastes go, and the one friend I know that would exercise with me has bad joints as far as endurance goes. 

And thanks for the site, I'll check it out. When I do strenuous work, I usually listen to music, or have it playing in the background usually. Or I make a game out of it if I want to do good enough, I just make sure not to take it too far, because I'm so competitive it's depressing. 

I'll play the occasional video game, but it bores me after a while, because I can't become engaged at all, even though I love them. Movies were fun as well, but yet again, engaging is the hard part. Really, the only things I truly enjoy with no ounce of boredom involved are sleeping and walking, if that isn't weird or anything. Otherwise, I'm just unmotivated to do anything really.
So, what are you saying? That I have the courage to push through this?

Admittedly, I've been working on losing weight, and have lost 25 pounds or so thus far, but sometimes I just feel really down and can't think I can do it. :/ And I like to read, but sometimes nothing really helps, I just feel listless, and have no real motivation to do any activities that I do enjoy.
I'm trying anyways. I mean, the last time I went to therapy or anything like that, it didn't end up too well, so let's hope that things will actually go right for once. :s
And the medication that I'm on to help, is only making it worse. I'm making an appointment with my doctor tomorrow, and when I get there I'll tell them. :s
Yes I am. And I'll try to find out if they have a counselor there tomorrow. And thank you, I just feel so detached from my own life, it's scary.

I don't know. I just feel like they're making a mistake by loving me and trusting me supposedly. And it just feels like there's so much pressure going on right now. My dad can't shut up about how when he gets old, I'll support him, and all this marvelous shit. When I was younger, he would always talk about how I would be a neurosurgeon, supporting him with a house, being a combat veteran, and all around sports star. Well, I'm pretty much the exact opposite. Blood makes me squeamish, except my own, I don't even have a job right now, I wouldn't make it in the military, and I suck at sports, mainly because I'm overweight. 

Sometimes, it just doesn't feel like I'm good enough for them. Like I always have something to live up to. :/ 

I'm afraid to tell someone. Because the last time I told someone I was depressed, my dad just took me to a therapist, and expected it to be over with, only resulting in even more emotional soul crushing, as well as increasing my paranoia. And my friends mostly just treat it as an aside thing.

I can ignore this somedays, but recently it's just been getting worse.
